name: Fireflies at Midnight
source:
Merlot is the deity of insects, and his powers are more of a drag than an advantage. He forgets something important, but once he remembers, his life is changed forever.

Play from Merlot's point of view and discover the problems of balancing regular life with powers.

[From [url=https://shn1010.itch.io/fireflies-at-midnight-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅洛是昆虫之神，他的力量与其说是优势，不如说是一种拖累。他忘记了一些重要的事情，但一旦他记起来，他的生活就永远改变了。

从梅洛的角度进行游戏，发现平衡日常生活与力量的问题。

[来自[url=https://shn1010.itch.io/fireflies-at-midnight-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
